speech_verification.heard: Signalmen hit a passenger train on the main line and forgot. On May 22, 1915, a troop train carrying soldiers slammed into the stalled service. An express train traveling in the opposite direction immediately plowed into the wreckage. Gas from the wooden carriages ignited, starting a massive fire that burned until morning. Over 200 people died in Britain's worst ever rail crash. Signalmen left a train on the main line.
